items: First version. A sitting takes one French story through four steps: listen without the text, read it and tap the words you don't know, take dictation at natural speed, then retell it in your own words.
The words you tap come back for review inside the sentence you met them in, and you type them.
Progress shows what you can do (words caught by ear, words understood, words produced from memory), with no points and no streak.
With an AI cowork folder, an agent writes new stories at your level and gives each sitting an honest grade.
